title: Simply supported beam under its own weight: deflection, bending stress and Q1 locking sweep (analytic)
description:
Half of a simply supported beam (span S = 2 mm, depth h = 100 um, plane strain) loaded by a uniform body force f_y (body_force feature). x_lo is the support: a displacement feature holding u_y = 0 with u_x free (the end section may rotate); x_hi is the mid-span symmetry plane (roller: u_x = 0). The sweep runs the cells over the depth n_h = 4, 8, 16 (square cells).
Analytic (Timoshenko beam, plane strain E' = E / (1 - nu^2), q = -f_y h per m of depth, I = h^3 / 12, shear factor 5/6): delta_mid = 5 q S^4 / (384 E' I) + 3 q S^2 / (20 G h) (the shear term is 0.7 % here); w(x) = q x (S^3 - 2 S x^2 + x^3) / (24 E' I) + 3 q x (S - x) / (5 G h); M(x) = q x (S - x) / 2, sigma_xx = -M (y - h/2) / I; support reaction F_y = q S / 2 (exact: equilibrium).
Bilinear elements lock in bending: the beam is too stiff by about c / n_h^2 with c = (1 - nu) / 2 (parasitic shear: the element edges stay straight, so gamma ~ kappa (x - x_cell)) + nu^2 / (1 - 2 nu) (eps_yy is constant over each element's depth while eps_xx varies linearly in it, so that part of the bending strain sees lambda + 2 mu instead of E'), c = 0.575 at nu = 0.3: delta_mid ~3.5 %, 0.9 %, 0.22 % low at n_h = 4, 8, 16 (dashed locking_estimate on the Sweep tab, matched to ~1e-3, tolerance 5e-3); the 2D elasticity solution differs from the Timoshenko formula by a few 1e-4 at S / h = 20.
Sweep tab: delta_mid vs n_h with the flat reference and the locking estimate.
Derived values tab: F_y_support (exact by equilibrium: the report's suspicious_exact flag is expected), delta_mid (probe on the neutral axis next to mid-span) and sigma_bottom_mid (largest tension, bottom cell next to mid-span), both within the locking error (tolerance 4 %, set by n_h = 4).
Line profile tab (last sweep value, n_h = 16): u_y_neutral along the neutral axis and sigma_xx_mid across the depth next to mid-span (~0.2 %).

parameters.description: cells over the depth (swept 4, 8, 16; square cells)

parameters.description: body force density along y in N/m^3 (downward)

parameters.description: downward line load in N/m per m of depth (100)

parameters.name: I_beam
parameters.description: second moment of area per m of depth in m^3

parameters.description: Euler-Bernoulli mid-span deflection in m (3.25 nm)

parameters.name: delta_shear
parameters.description: Timoshenko shear deflection in m (shear factor 5/6)

parameters.description: analytic mid-span deflection magnitude in m
